synopsis: A 2025 Springer article is cited for an Indian DGMS circular setting a maximum speed of 30 km/h and establishing proximity-warning requirements [f2304, f2305]. Separately, a 2024 Springer paper proposes extending operating design domain concepts to unstructured environments [f6712]. The corpus classifies that proposal, alongside ODD-UM and a November 2025 agricultural ODD framework, as academic work rather than standards, leaving a standardization gap for off-road operating-domain taxonomies [f6710]. Thus, Springer's role here spans reporting regulatory requirements and publishing proposed domain frameworks; the latter should not be treated as standardized acceptance criteria [f2304, f2305, f6710, f6712].

relations.note: Clarifies that the 2024 unstructured-environment proposal is academic, not a standard.
Adds proximity-warning requirements to the speed limit attributed to the cited DGMS circular.
